/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionList */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.EDU_TYPE_CD AS eduTypeCd , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate /* 연계 위험성평가 수 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK R WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND R.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD ) AS riskCount /* 출결 집계(출결 테이블 미사용 단계에서는 0). DEL_YN='N' 기준 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS attendanceCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'COMPLETED' ) AS completedCount , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE AT WHERE AT.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND AT.SESSION_CD = A.SESSION_CD AND AT.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AT.COMPLETION_STATUS_CD = 'NOT_COMPLETED' ) AS notCompletedCount FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD )
/* 상태 우선순위(IN_PROGRESS > OPENED > DRAFT > COMPLETED > CANCELLED) -> 개설일/등록일 desc */ ORDER BY CASE A.STATUS_CD WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'OPENED' THEN 2 WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN 3 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 4 WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END , A.INSERT_DATE DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionDetail */ SELECT A.SESSION_CD AS sessionCd , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , ST.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.EDU_TYPE_CD AS eduTypeCd , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT_BODY AS contentBody , A.CONTENT_FORMAT_CD AS contentFormatCd , A.STATUS_CD AS statusCd , SC.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS statusNm , A.ENTRY_PWD AS entryPwd , A.EXIT_PWD AS exitPwd , A.MANAGER_USER_CD AS managerUserCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.MANAGER_USER_CD, NULL) AS managerUserNm , A.MANAGER_GPS_LAT AS managerGpsLat , A.MANAGER_GPS_LON AS managerGpsLon , A.GPS_VERIFY_TYPE_CD AS gpsVerifyTypeCd , A.GPS_VERIFY_RADIUS_M AS gpsVerifyRadiusM , A.GPS_MANUAL_CONFIRM_YN AS gpsManualConfirmYn , DATE_FORMAT(A.OPENED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS openedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.STARTED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS startedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.ENDED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS endedAt , DATE_FORMAT(A.CANCELLED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS cancelledAt , A.CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, 'USER_NM', A.INSERT_NO, NULL) AS insertNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate FROM TB_TBM_SESSION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE ST ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = ST.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = ST.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS046' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SC ON ( A.STATUS_CD = SC.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionContents */ SELECT SC.MTRL_CD AS mtrlCd , M.TITLE AS title , M.MTRL_TYPE AS mtrlType , BD.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS mtrlTypeNm , ( SELECT COUNT(I.MTRL_ITEM_CD) FROM TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL_ITEM I WHERE I.MTRL_CD = SC.MTRL_CD AND I.USE_YN = 'Y' ) AS itemCnt , SC.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder , SC.OVERRIDE_DESC AS overrideDesc FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_CONTENT SC LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TBM_EDU_MTRL M ON ( SC.MTRL_CD = M.MTRL_CD AND SC.CMPNY_CD = M.CMPNY_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON ( BD.CMPNY_CD = SC.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM003' AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = M.MTRL_TYPE AND BD.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE SC.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SC.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} ORDER BY SC.DISPLAY_ORDER

/* Tbm02Mapper.selectSessionRisks */ SELECT SR.SITE_CD AS siteCd , SR.PROCESS_CD AS processCd , C.BAIM_VAL_D_NM AS processNm , RA.RISK_TYPE_CD AS riskTypeCd , RT.RISK_TYPE_NM AS riskTypeNm , RA.HAZARD_CD AS hazardCd , CASE WHEN RA.HAZARD_CD = 'self' THEN RA.ASSESSMENT_DESC ELSE E.HAZARD_NM END AS hazardNm , SR.ASSESSMENT_CD AS assessmentCd , RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS AS assessmentStatus , B.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS assessmentStatusNm , SR.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM TB_TBM_SESSION_RISK SR INNER JOIN TB_RISK_ASSESSMENT RA ON ( SR.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND SR.SITE_CD = RA.SITE_CD AND SR.PROCESS_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND SR.ASSESSMENT_CD = RA.ASSESSMENT_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.SYST_VAL_D_CD, D.SYST_VAL_D_NM FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D D WHERE D.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS011' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON ( RA.ASSESSMENT_STATUS = B.SYST_VAL_D_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D C ON ( C.CMPNY_CD = RA.CMPNY_CD AND C.BAIM_VAL_CD = 'COM002' AND C.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = RA.PROCESS_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_TYPE RT ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = RT.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = RT.RISK_TYPE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_RISK_SITE_HAZARD E ON ( RA.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND RA.RISK_TYPE_CD = E.RISK_TYPE_CD AND RA.HAZARD_CD = E.HAZARD_CD ) WHERE SR.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND SR.SESSION_CD = #{sessionCd} ORDER BY SR.DISPLAY_ORDER
mapper.update: /* Tbm02Mapper.upsertSessionState */ INSERT INTO TB_TBM_SESSION_STATE ( CMPNY_CD , SESSION_CD , CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX , SYNC_STATE_CD , LAST_UPDATED_BY , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{sessionCd} , 0 , 'PAUSED' , #{gvUserCd} , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX = NEW.CURRENT_SLIDE_INDEX , SYNC_STATE_CD = NEW.SYNC_STATE_CD , LAST_UPDATED_BY = NEW.LAST_UPDATED_BY , UPDATE_NO = NEW.INSERT_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
